decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures that the required brand-colour details and codes are included while a separate guidelines document is excluded.
The same-message MODIFY already records the client's selection of the three standard colour variants: full colour, black, and white.
Clarifying that brand colour and font details are not a separate guidelines project does not alter the requirement for fully editable source files.
The source clarification does not change the separately confirmed delivery of logo versions with and without the black box.
The documentation-scope clarification does not change the company wording or exclusion of the word 'truck' from the logo.
References to included font details concern brand-reference documentation and do not modify the approved logo letterforms.
The source distinguishes included brand-colour details from a separate guidelines project but does not change the approved logo colour treatment.
The clarification about brand-reference details does not replace or modify the approved rev8-11 composition baseline.
The source does not alter the logo's visual-character direction or ornamentation constraint.
Limiting the requested guidance to colour and font details does not alter the logo's required suitability across applications.
The source clarification does not modify the strapline side lines or its graduated-colour treatment.
The documentation clarification has no effect on the flame-based O or its recognition requirement.
